EvidenceRecord.title: EvidenceRecord
EvidenceRecord.description:
A single observed value with the provenance docs/05 requires.

`value` is an integer because every MVP metric is a count or an integer
rupiah amount. A metric that genuinely needs fractions must extend this
contract with a new version rather than silently introduce floats.

SyntheticSimulation.title: SyntheticSimulation
SyntheticSimulation.description:
Counts, never shares.

docs/04 is explicit that a synthetic purchase share is not a conversion
rate. Reporting "9 dari 16 persona" keeps the denominator visible, where a
percentage next to real market data would read as a measurement.
